description: Buddy Phase 20 — Module Wiring & Live Integration. Phases 1-19 built 73 modules, but gap analysis reveals Phase 19's 6 production hardening modules (health_registry, replay_validator, observation_consumer, agent_lifecycle, module_activation, memory_manager) are initialized but NEVER CALLED during scan cycles. Phase 20 focuses entirely on wiring: dispatch calls in the scan loop, pre/post-flight health checks, observation consumption feedback, agent lifecycle weight application, module activation scheduling, and orchestrator integration. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Health registry pre/post-flight wiring in scan loop
userStories.description: Wire HealthRegistry into engine.py scan loop so preflight runs before scanning and postflight runs after execution. Abort cycle if health score drops below threshold.
acceptanceCriteria: In engine.py scan() method, call self._health_registry.run_preflight() before main scan logic
If should_continue_cycle() returns False, log warning and return early from scan
After execution phase, call self._health_registry.run_postflight()
Register all existing Phase 19 modules as health-checkable (memory_manager, module_activation, etc.)
Call health_registry.save_state() at end of cycle
Guarded by enable_health_registry config flag (existing)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Already wired in engine.py lines 2640-2657 (preflight) and 2744-2754 (postflight). _register_health_checks() at lines 2800-2830. Verified 2026-03-22.

userStories.title: Agent lifecycle fitness tracking wired into trade outcomes
userStories.description: Wire AgentLifecycleManager into the execution feedback loop so agent fitness updates after every trade close, and weight modifiers are applied during vote aggregation.
acceptanceCriteria: After trade close in execution.py or RL sync, call agent_lifecycle.update_fitness(agent_name, won, regime)
In agents.py vote aggregation, apply agent_lifecycle.get_weight_modifier(agent_name) as multiplier
Quarantined agents (0.30x) and retired agents (0.0x) reflected in weighted_vote_score
Log agent status transitions (ACTIVE→QUARANTINED, etc.) to observation_log
Call agent_lifecycle.save_state() after fitness updates
Guarded by enable_agent_lifecycle config flag (existing)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Wired: continuous.py lines 565-600 (update_fitness after RL sync), agents/_team.py lines 805-812 (get_weight_modifier in vote aggregation), engine.py line 509 (lifecycle injection). Added observation_log integration for status transitions 2026-03-22.

userStories.title: Observation consumer wired into continuous scan loop
userStories.description: Wire ObservationConsumer into the continuous scanner so observations are periodically consumed, patterns detected, and recommendations surfaced.
acceptanceCriteria: In continuous.py, call observation_consumer.consume_observations() every N cycles (configurable, default 10)
After consuming, call detect_patterns() and recommend_adjustments()
Feed recommendations to config_tuner if available (log otherwise)
Call check_alerts() and log any spike alerts as warnings
Call observation_consumer.save_state() after processing
Guarded by enable_observation_consumer config flag (existing)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Already wired in continuous.py lines 242-285. consume_observations() every 10 cycles, detect_patterns(), recommend_adjustments() fed to ConfigTuner, check_alerts() logged as warnings, save_state() called. Verified 2026-03-22.

userStories.title: Module activation dispatcher with cycle-based scheduling
userStories.description: Wire ModuleActivationMap as the central dispatcher that controls which modules run each cycle based on their registered frequency.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/module_dispatcher.py with ModuleDispatcher class
register_all_modules() auto-registers all enabled Phase 15-19 modules with appropriate frequencies
dispatch_cycle(cycle_number) calls module_activation.get_modules_to_run() and executes them
Expensive modules (replay_validator, model_calibration) run every 10-20 cycles
Lightweight modules (memory_manager, health_registry) run every cycle
Integrate dispatcher into continuous.py main loop
Guarded by enable_module_activation config flag (existing)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: module_dispatcher.py created (274 lines). 24 modules registered with frequencies from 1 (lightweight) to 20 (expensive). Wired into continuous.py lines 409-418. Verified 2026-03-22.

userStories.title: Replay validator drift detection wired with auto-correction
userStories.description: Wire ReplayValidator into periodic drift checks that feed results back to threshold_optimizer and config_tuner for auto-correction.

run_drift_check(pair, recent_candles) calls replay_validator.replay_scan() + detect_drift()
If drift detected, generate config adjustment recommendation and feed to config_tuner
If drift exceeds critical threshold (>20%), log critical alert and reduce position sizing
Schedule drift checks every 20 cycles via module_dispatcher
Persist drift monitoring state to trained_data/drift_monitor_log.json
Guarded by enable_replay_validator config flag (existing)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: drift_monitor.py created with DriftMonitor class. Wired into continuous.py lines 327-356 (every 20 cycles). Drift severity mild/critical handled. Config adjustments fed to config_tuner. State persisted. Verified 2026-03-22.

userStories.title: Memory manager wired into watch mode with periodic cleanup
userStories.description: Wire MemoryManager into the continuous scanner for periodic cache eviction, log rotation, and RSS monitoring with pressure-based throttling.
acceptanceCriteria: In continuous.py, call memory_manager.evict_lru() every cycle
Call memory_manager.rotate_log() for all log files every 50 cycles
Call memory_manager.get_memory_report() every 10 cycles and log RSS
If RSS exceeds WARNING threshold, reduce scan frequency
If RSS exceeds CRITICAL threshold, trigger emergency cache clear and log alert
Register all major caches (model_cache, candle_cache, etc.) with memory_manager
Call memory_manager.save_state() after cleanup cycles
Guarded by enable_memory_manager config flag (existing)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Wired in continuous.py lines 373-407. run_cleanup() every cycle (evict+rotate combined). RSS monitoring every 10 cycles with rss_warning/rss_critical boolean checks. Emergency cache clear on critical. Caches registered (cached_candles, feature_snapshots, raw_snapshots, pair_returns). Log files registered (observations.jsonl, trade_journal_rl.json, scan_cycle_log.json). Fixed bug: was checking non-existent 'pressure' field, now uses rss_warning/rss_critical booleans. Verified 2026-03-22.
